title: Very small. Odd hanging option.
text: Very small. Odd hanging option.. These are so small I can barely fit a coffee mug in them. With no middle shelf, it’s not an efficient use of my space. The holes to mount are a pain. Make sure to measure your space then mark 3/4 of an inch to the left because the holes in the shelves slide to “lock” into place. The color is pretty. It’s a rich dark stain. The quality is just okay.

features: Dark Walnut Finish Hexagon Shelving - Put these wall mounted mango wood floating shelves in every room! Three honeycomb shaped shelves are so sturdy, they'll provide valuable extra storage. The gorgeous wooden grain and beautiful Indian craftsmanship add appeal to the walls of your bathroom, living room, bedroom, or study - or even a hotel lobby!

An Original and Breathtaking Present - The wooden hexagon wall shelves are an impactful gift, regardless of the occasion. Give them as a housewarming gift, an anniversary gift, a birthday gift, or for Hanukkah or Christmas. The durable craftsmanship, sustainable mango wood, and stunning appeal present in each hexagon shelf are unforgettable!

Incredibly Durable, With A Pretty Grain - The wooden hexagon shelves arrive separately wrapped, so that premium walnut finish doesn't get scratched en route. The joints of the hanging hexagon shelves are firmly glued and pinned, so they won't come apart. Display your books, plants and crystals on the hexagon hanging shelves with confidence.

Three Varying Sizes for Visual Appeal - Each of these natural wood floating shelves is a different size. Hang all 3 room shelves side by side to create contrast and interest. Anchors and screws are included, and the honeycomb shelves arrive already assembled, so all you have to do is to mount them on the wall. Then decorate as you please!

Indian Craftsmanship At Home - Bring a little of India's artisanal mystique home with you with these hexagon shelves. The wall mounted floating shelves are made of sustainable mango wood, and arrive already assembled. Simply hang the rustic wall shelves in every room to display books, plants, crystals, photos, or knick knacks and collectibles.
description: These Hexagon Shape Wall Shelves Are Pretty and Practical at the Same Time A hexagon display shelf can make quite the difference in any room - especially one that's handcrafted in India from sustainable mango wood. Use the bedroom hexagon shelves to display a pretty photo frame and your crystal collection, or mount the hexagon shaped shelves in the bathroom for plants and toiletries. The hexagon essential oil shelf looks great in the study - or display the 3 hexagon shelves in the living room in a diagonal formation for contrast and aesthetic appeal.>/br> Each of the 3 wall hexagon shelves in this set comes already assembled. Furthermore, the honeycomb shelves are individually packed to protect that beautiful walnut finish. The honeycomb plant shelf set should arrive perfectly intact. Since the hexagon floating shelves are handcrafted, you'll see incredible detail and care when you inspect the shelves up close. Put a trio in every room in your house to add a little oomph to your storage and displays. Wave goodbye to shelves that fall apart when you stack a few books; these are so durable, they'll withstand the test of time. Great as a present for friends or family who have excellent taste! You'll soon be recognized as the gift-giver with impeccable style!
